nom: Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum lightened acne-related dark spots noticeably after about a month of use.
segments.dry: Reports from dry-skin reviewers are mixed: one describes immediate burning with no fading of two stubborn dark spots, while others with dry or naturally dry skin say the serum did not add extra dryness and helped lighten spots from sun exposure.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who names combination skin found the serum lightweight and non-heavy, layering fine with the rest of her routine and causing no breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and continued use, but one reviewer describes a severe reaction with facial swelling and hives after two applications.
segments.mature: A mature-skin reviewer with freckles, dark spots, wrinkles, and rosacea reports no stinging and is watching for further change with continued use.
segments.normal: The same reviewer who describes her skin as mature also calls it normal, reporting no irritation from the serum.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report their dark spots fading gradually over several weeks to a couple of months, often describing the change as subtle rather than dramatic; a few reviewers report no visible difference even after three to four weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no breakouts while using the serum, but a handful describe new breakouts appearing in places they don't normally get them, including one reviewer who stopped use because of it.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the serum as hydrating or at least non-drying despite its brightening actives, though one reviewer with dry skin reports it burned and irritated her skin on first use.
concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the serum softened fine lines alongside fading her dark spots, though this is a secondary observation not widely corroborated elsewhere.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports noticing a reduction in redness in addition to the serum's dark-spot effect, a benefit not mentioned elsewhere in the reviews.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue right after application
Medicinal or glue-like scent for some users
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling
Pump dispenses a consistent, appropriate amount
Expensive for the amount of product

extraits.texte: This is NOT for those with sensitive skin. Tried this out one night - next morning had a swollen eye and red hives all over my face and neck.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review and opinion. I was very disappointed with this serum. I like all the other Murad products Ive tried but I think this one is a complete bust. I used one pump and my face felt super sticky afterwards. I didn't see any visible results either. Ive been using this product for a little over 3 weeks and I have 2 very distinct dark spots. One on my cheekbone and the other a little lower on my cheek in the smile line area. They didn't lighten up whatsoever. I have dry skin and it burned my skin immediately. It did leave irritation but it didn't last very long. On the bottle it said to discontinue use of that occurred so I just dropped it down to using only once a day instead of twice. I think that's why it didn't stay irritated for very long. I would not recommend or purchase this product for that sole reason. I am 44 and I thought this would be great to supplement my skincare routine. Much to my dismay, it does not! Maybe next time Murad!

Amazing product for those with oily skin. I had a lot of dark spots due to acne and after a month of applying I did see a big improvement they became much lighter so the more your consistence with it the better it works also use with suncream!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this dark spot correcting serum and the fact that it can be applied all over your face and not just target areas. I have combination skin and It's not heavy at all, I can apply all of my other skin care products without my face feeling weighed down or a feeling of clogged pores. Theres a slight chemical scent but it doesn't last long. So far no breakouts and I feel like it's really working for me.

extraits.titre: Attacks dark spots like a boss
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love Murad's packaging, it's so sleek and eye pleasing. Of all my skincare the vibrancy of this bottle catches my eye every evening. With that said, I have been using this for a couple weeks now, and I can say that some of my dark spots have most definitely faded. I am really good with sunscreen so fortunately I don't have a lot of spots to contend with. I wanted to post a before and after but just couldn't get the lighting good enough for accuracy. So just take my word for it! The texture is a little tacky, which I feel is better for gripping onto the skin. There is no scent, which doesn't bother me either way. I naturally have dry skin, but didn't notice extra dryness in the areas I used it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Murad serum feels good going on, absorbs quickly. It has a light pleasant scent. The serum is thicker, not watery, and I like that. It didn't cause any stinging or skin irritation for me. I have mature, normal skin with some freckles, dark spots, wrinkles and rosacea. Can't wait to see how my skin changes as I finish the full bottle! So far so good.

I've been using this rapid dark spot correcting serum for about 6 weeks now and I can physically see the difference. Also others around me has been complementing on how bright I look as well. I have had any peeling or itching so that's great. I do have sensitive and combination from oily to dry skin. The consistency is pretty thin so be careful when pushing the pump. I highly recommend this and it's effective.
